name: Background Volume Rendering with Sparse Grid
definition: A volume rendering technique that handles background content (e.g., sky, distant geometry) using a separate sparse grid structure, distinct from the foreground scene representation. It allows for efficient rendering of unbounded or distant background elements by treating them as a separate volumetric field accessed via ray traversal.
summary: Background Volume Rendering with Sparse Grid renders distant elements using a separate sparse grid, enabling efficient, distinct resolution and sampling strategies for background versus foreground.
